title: NEBULA: Seven Fake AI SDK Packages on npm Install a Windows RAT That Needs No DLL
content: In late September 2026, an actor deployed seven malicious npm packages masquerading as a NebulaAI software development kit to deliver a Windows remote-access trojan. The operation, tracked as NEBULA, spans four sequential burner accounts (nebulallms through nebulallms4), with api-nebula and llm-nebula remaining downloadable. title: Unknown Threat Actor Uses AI-Driven ARTEX to Target South Korean Finance
content: An unidentified threat actor, likely Chinese-speaking and financially motivated, conducted targeted attacks against South Korean financial institutions between late September and early October 2026, successfully exfiltrating data. title: Threat Actors Exploit Critical AhsayCBS Flaws to Drop Webshells and XMRig Cryptominer
content: Beginning October 7, 2026, threat actors exploited two critical vulnerabilities in AhsayCBS backup utility (CVE-2026-105133 and CVE-2026-105134) to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution on exposed systems. title: MATCHBOIL: New tricks, same old evil intentions
content: ESET researchers documented the evolution of MATCHBOIL, a custom C# downloader used by Russia-aligned APT group UAC-0099. The malware downloads payloads from command-and-control servers, installs them, and establishes persistence on victim machines.
